title: Ghislaine Maxwell's Swedish male aides and collected hair
place_text: Ghislaine Maxwell's Upper East Side townhouse, Manhattan

tellings.quote: the aids who worked for Glenn Maxwell, the she had these live-in male aids at her apartment in the upper east side of Manhattan at her townhouse.

plain: The British socialite Ghislaine Maxwell is said to have kept live-in male Swedish aides at her townhouse on Manhattan's Upper East Side, and to have collected hair. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells this, drawing on an article by an unnamed former Swedish aide and his own online essay about Maxwell. He raises it as a sign of something stranger going on in her household.
